data.summary:
[Inevitable Death](vsdata:ability/aeldari.the-yncarne.inevitable-death) on The Yncarne is rewritten. Once during each of your opponent's turns, right after the last model of another **AELDARI** unit of yours is removed as **destroyed**, you may do this if The Yncarne is on the battlefield:

1. Remove The Yncarne from the battlefield.
2. Set it up as near as possible to the spot where that last model was destroyed, outside **[Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** of all enemy units.

This does not stop The Yncarne being eligible to move.
